mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, booklist_id, LEAST(5, -- 评分上限为5分 (total_views * 0.35 + total_collects * 0.65 + -- 权重系数减半 CASE WHEN total_duration < 6000 THEN 0 WHEN total_duration < 20000 THEN 0.5 -- 分值减半 WHEN total_duration < 60000 THEN 1 -- 分值减半 ELSE 1.5 -- 分值减半 END ) / GREATEST(1, (total_views + total_collects)) * 5 -- 调整分母为5 ) AS score FROM ( SELECT user_id, booklist_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, -- 2-点击 SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_collects, -- 1-收藏 SUM(CASE WHEN type = 4 THEN stay_time ELSE 0 END) AS total_duration -- 4-停留时长 FROM user_action WHERE type IN (1, 2, 4) -- 类型：1-收藏；2-点击；4-停留时长 GROUP BY user_id, booklist_id HAVING total_views > 0 OR total_collects > 0 ) AS aggregated_data ORDER BY score DESC;
